id: 08_EquiTips CO₂ Understanding Carbon Dioxide and Its Applications
title: 二氧化碳与干冰的安全使用
source_doc: course/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/08_EquiTips CO₂ Understanding Carbon Dioxide and Its Applications.md
author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/08_EquiTips CO₂ Understanding Carbon Dioxide and Its Applications/src.py

points.S5: 有人晕倒，不要贸然进去

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室里，旁边是一只用链条固定的二氧化碳钢瓶和一个装干冰的泡沫箱，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab beside a carbon dioxide cylinder chained to the wall and an open foam box of dry ice with white mist, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲二氧化碳和干冰的安全使用。
overlay: 二氧化碳与干冰的安全使用

shots.scene: 气泡饮料、干冰、钢瓶、警示三角四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a fizzy drink, a dry ice block, a gas cylinder and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 它很有用，但也会让人窒息。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一大箱干冰，走进一个没有窗户的小储藏间
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a large box of dry ice into a small windowless storage closet.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把一大箱干冰放进小储藏间。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一块干冰往带螺旋盖的塑料瓶里塞
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to push a chunk of dry ice into a screw-cap plastic bottle.
shots.narration: 还想装几块进塑料瓶里带走。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向门外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to the open corridor outside.
shots.narration: 小研说：这两件事，都很危险！

shots.scene: CO2分子模型：一个碳原子两边各一个氧原子
shots.prompt_en: A simple molecule model of carbon dioxide: one carbon atom between two oxygen atoms. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳是一种常见的气体。

shots.scene: 工厂烟囱和地球图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a factory chimney and a globe with a thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 人们常从排放和气候来谈它。

shots.scene: 水滴、医疗十字、建筑、食品、麦穗五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a water drop, a medical cross, a building, a food plate and a wheat stalk. No people.
shots.narration: 水处理、医疗、食品、农业都用它。

shots.scene: 实验室里的二氧化碳培养箱
shots.prompt_en: A cell culture incubator connected by a thin line to a carbon dioxide cylinder in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的细胞培养箱也离不开它。

shots.scene: 一杯冒气泡的汽水
shots.prompt_en: A glass of sparkling water with rising bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 饮料里的气泡，就是二氧化碳。

shots.scene: 泡沫箱里的干冰冒着白雾，旁边是冷藏的食品
shots.prompt_en: A foam box with dry ice pellets giving off white fog next to chilled food packages. No people.
shots.narration: 干冰是固态二氧化碳，用来冷藏。

shots.scene: 冷链运输箱里装着样品管和干冰
shots.prompt_en: An insulated shipping box with sample tubes surrounded by dry ice, the lid loosely closed. No people.
shots.narration: 疫苗和样品，常用干冰低温运输。

shots.scene: 温室里的作物长得茂盛
shots.prompt_en: A greenhouse with lush green crops growing in rows. No people.
shots.narration: 温室里补充二氧化碳，作物长得好。

shots.scene: 欣欣一手拿汽水，一手指着警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a fizzy drink in one hand and points to a yellow warning triangle with the other.
shots.narration: 它很有用，但用不好也会伤人。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白的安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank safety handbook with a cylinder icon on the cover.
shots.narration: 要按危害管理规定来使用。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳从钢瓶漏出，沉到地面，形成一层淡色气体
shots.prompt_en: Carbon dioxide leaks from a cylinder and sinks to the floor, forming a pale layer. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳比空气重，会沉在低处。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标和眼睛图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon and an eye icon, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 无色无味，闻不到也看不见。

shots.scene: 地下室、冷库、小储藏间三个图标上方警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a basement, a cold room and a small closet, each with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 地下室、冷库、小房间最容易积聚。

shots.scene: 人倒地的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning icon of a person collapsing to the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度高了，人会很快失去意识。

shots.scene: 徒手拿干冰的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing dry ice, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干冰极冷，徒手拿会冻伤。

shots.scene: 小研戴防冻手套和护目镜，用夹子夹干冰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears cryogenic gloves and safety goggles and picks up dry ice with tongs.
shots.narration: 戴防冻手套、护目镜，用工具夹。

shots.scene: 带螺旋盖的瓶子里装着干冰，瓶子胀裂的示意，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a tightly capped bottle with dry ice inside bulging and cracking, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干冰不能装进密闭容器，会爆裂。

shots.scene: 干冰放在没盖严的泡沫箱里，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Dry ice in a foam box with a loose-fitting lid, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 用不密封的保温箱盛放。

shots.scene: 车厢里和小储藏间里堆着干冰的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of dry ice boxes inside a closed car and inside a tiny closet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在车内、密闭小屋里大量存放。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳钢瓶直立，用链条固定在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide cylinder stands upright, chained to a wall bracket away from a heater. No people.
shots.narration: 钢瓶直立固定，远离热源。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是钢瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing a gas cylinder icon.
shots.narration: 气瓶按特种设备规定管理。

shots.scene: 扳手拧带压接头的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench loosening a fitting on a pressurized cylinder line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 换瓶前先关阀泄压，不得带压拆卸。

shots.scene: 培养室墙上的报警器和排风口
shots.prompt_en: A gas alarm unit and an exhaust vent on the wall of a cell culture room with incubators. No people.
shots.narration: 放钢瓶、干冰的房间要通风。

shots.scene: 报警器灯亮，排风扇转动
shots.prompt_en: The wall alarm lights up and an exhaust fan starts spinning. No people.
shots.narration: 必要时装二氧化碳或氧含量报警。

shots.scene: 小研进门前看一眼报警器绿灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the green light on the wall alarm before entering the room.
shots.narration: 进门前先看报警器是否正常。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒，不要贸然进去
shots.scene: 小房间里有人倒地，门外的人要冲进去的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person collapsed in a small room and another person rushing in, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人晕倒在里面，不要冲进去。
overlay: 有人晕倒，不要贸然进去

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒，不要贸然进去
shots.scene: 小研打开门窗和排风，在门外呼救
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student props the door open, switches on the exhaust fan from outside and calls for help.
shots.narration: 在外面开门通风，大声呼救。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒，不要贸然进去
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 立即拨打119、120，报告负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现汽水、培养箱、干冰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a fizzy drink, an incubator and dry ice.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳用途广，但不能大意。

shots.scene: 低处积聚、密闭瓶爆裂两个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Two warning icons: gas pooling near the floor and a sealed bottle bursting. No people.
shots.narration: 会积在低处，干冰不能密封。

shots.scene: 手套、固定链条、报警器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of cryogenic gloves, a cylinder chain and a wall alarm. No people.
shots.narration: 戴手套，瓶固定，房间通风有报警。

shots.scene: 门外呼救和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person calling for help outside a door and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 有人晕倒不硬闯，拨打119、120。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一杯汽水向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a glass of sparkling water and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 了解它，尊重它，安全用它，下次见！
